messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: eu-central-dedicated pool 'eu-c-1' CPU pressure + queue depth spike > 90% for 6m. autoscaler attempted 2x but failed -> thin-pool threshold triggered. See /alerts/1959123000

alex: saw this, grabbing. how bad is the spillover to hosted? any visible error rates?

monitor-bot: hosted fallback active for low-priority orgs (lp-*) at 15% traffic. no error rate increase; latency for hosted path +50ms median.

maria: thanks. quick context: yesterday's provisioning run didn't finish due to networking flaps to eu-c AZ2, so effective GPU capacity is ~75% of target. pool has many small orgs queued. we should avoid bulk weight swap to hosted because cost can spike. propose gradual drain: bump hosted weight for lp-* by +10% every 10m until pool <70% util or queue <500.

sam: +1 gradual. also suggest we offload model variants that are quantized-only to hosted (they're cheaper there) and keep high-memory pinned to dedicated. can add cost-signal to stop after expected spend +$X/hour.

jin: current numbers: dedicated pool eu-c-1: 48 GPUs, 42 active (killed some due to AZ2 net error), qlen=1.2k requests, p95 latency 420ms. hosted absorbing ~180 rps for lp orgs. Dedicated overload if we don't shift ~30m.

alex: plan sounds good. i'll own the roll. steps: 1) set cost cutoff for hosted ramp, 2) start 10% bump for lp-*, 3) monitor queue and latency, 4) if errors >0.5% revert.

maria: put the exact commands here pls. also flag the orgs we consider low-priority (lp-analytics, lp-staging, lp-experiments).

sam: Command to adjust traffic weights (weight-controller API):

```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-central","selector":"org:lp-*","action":"ramp","delta_pct":10}'
```

monitor-bot: NOTE: automated cost-signal hook will abort ramp if projected hourly hosted spend increase > $1200.

alex: starting first 10% ramp now. tagging in @jin for observation.

deploy-bot: weight-controller: accepted request id=wc-1959123000-1 state=running

alex: done. queue dropped from 1.2k -> 980 in 4m. p95 latency down to 360ms.

jin: seeing reduced queue, good. AZ2 net errors still noisy (10-15/min). I'm going to cordon 2 nodes that are flapping and kick a resize to reprovision replacements.

maria: cordon + reprovision sounds right. but avoid mass eviction; we'll do 2 nodes at a time. can you post the commands?

jin: kubectl drain node/eu-c-az2-045 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data && autoscaler api call to reprovision. doing it sequentially.

sam: after second ramp (another +10%) we should also toggle prefix-cache policy to reduce tokens per request for lp orgs (shorter prefix TTL). that'll give more headroom.

alex: starting second 10% bump in 8m if metrics stay stable. current hosted spend projection +$420/hr -> under cutoff.

monitor-bot: update: after second bump hosted absorbing 32% of lp traffic, queue = 420, p95=310ms, error=0.08%. projected spend +$980/hr.

maria: good. can we annotate the routing change with a reason in audit log? we need the entry for billing & postmortem (tag: incident/eu-c-1959123000).

deploy-bot: audit: routing-change id=wc-1959123000-2 reason="gradual drain - net flaps" user=alex

alex: starting managed cordon/reprovision on 2 nodes now. will watch queue.

jin: cordon done on node 045, reprovision requested. node 046 still in flight. slight spike in p95 during eviction (-> 470ms) but queue stable.

alex: once reprovision finishes we'll reduce hosted weight back by -15% in controlled steps if dedicated pool recovers. do not fully collapse ramp in <20m to avoid thrash.

sam: cost note: shifting these orgs to hosted increases per-token cost ~1.8x but reduces preemptible eviction risk. recommend finance notify lp-* owners about likely bill delta.

maria: i'll ping growth & finance. alex, how long until pool healthy?

alex: ETA for two replacement nodes 18-22m. if AZ2 stabilizes we might be back to normal by then.

monitor-bot: reprovision complete for node 046; node status Ready. pool active GPUs=48. queue=220. p95=295ms.

jin: marking AZ2 as degraded but stable. leaving cordoned drain policy off once nodes pass health checks 2 cycles.

alex: decreasing hosted weight by -10% now (controlled).

deploy-bot: weight-controller: accepted request id=wc-1959123000-3 state=running

alex: hosted weight reduced. queue trending -> 130. p95 260ms. hosted spend projection down to +$220/hr.

maria: great. I'll create a short postmortem note: root cause = AZ2 networking flaps + delayed provisioning; mitigation = gradual hosted ramp + node reprovision + cost-signal guard. action items: 1) add pre-run check to provisioning job to validate AZ networking health, 2) increase thin-pool alert margin by +5% to get earlier ramp, 3) label low-priority orgs for automatic fallback.

sam: +1 on adding prefix-cache TTL change as an automated step for lp orgs during ramps. reduces tokens and cost.

alex: closing thread; will file incident/eu-c-1959123000 with logs and timeline. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

monitor-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: eu-central-dedicated pool stabilized. final metrics: peak queue 1.2k -> final 112, max hosted absorb 34%, no customer-visible errors above baseline.
